properties.description: Shared identifier used to connect this drawer with one or more triggers.

properties.name: Drawer ID

properties.description: Controls slide direction, default open state, and dismissal behavior.

properties.description: Edge the drawer should slide from.

properties.name: Default Open

properties.name: Dismissible

properties.name: CSS Class
properties.description: Root class style preset for the drawer surface.

properties.name: Targeting
properties.description: Connect this trigger to a drawer root by ID.

properties.name: Target Drawer ID
properties.description: ID of the drawer this trigger should open. Must match identity.drawerId.

properties.name: Content
properties.description: Fallback content used when the trigger slot is empty.

properties.name: Label
properties.description: Fallback trigger label used only when the trigger slot is empty.

properties.name: Settings
properties.description: Behavior flags for the trigger button.

properties.description: Classes applied to the trigger button.

properties.description: Default style preset for the trigger button.

properties.name: Settings
properties.description: Behavior flags for the close button.

properties.name: Disabled

properties.description: Classes applied to the close button.

properties.name: CSS Class
properties.description: Default style preset for the close button.

1843.name: Navigation Menu

properties.name: Structure
properties.description: Choose the element used for the navigation menu root.

properties.name: HTML Tag
properties.description: HTML tag used for the menu root element.

properties.name: Identity
properties.description: Shared identifier used by mobile helpers to find and mirror this desktop menu.

properties.name: Menu ID
properties.description: Shared menu ID that Navigation Menu Mobile uses to connect to this menu.

properties.name: Settings
properties.description: Controls root orientation and optional animated viewport behavior.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Changes keyboard navigation semantics and layout direction for the root menu.

properties.name: Use Animated Menu
properties.description: Enables the generated viewport that animates dropdown panel changes.

properties.name: Use Full Width
properties.description: Allows the animated viewport to align to a wider container instead of the trigger width.

properties.name: Full Width Enabled
properties.description: Shows the full-width target selector only when full-width mode is enabled.

properties.name: Full Width Target Selector
properties.description: Selector used to measure the width target when full-width mode is enabled.

properties.name: Styling
properties.description: Classes applied to the menu root and optional animated viewport.

properties.name: CSS Class
properties.description: Root class style preset for the desktop menu wrapper.

properties.name: Animated Menu Enabled
properties.description: Shows the viewport class only when animated menu mode is enabled.

properties.name: Viewport CSS Class
properties.description: Class style preset for the generated animated viewport container.

properties.name: Accessibility
properties.description: Accessible naming for the navigation landmark.

properties.name: Nav Aria Label
properties.description: Accessible name applied to the nav landmark via aria-label.

properties.description: Classes applied to the authored list of navigation items.

properties.name: Settings
properties.description: Behavior flags for the authored menu item wrapper.

properties.description: Default style preset for the navigation item wrapper.

properties.name: Identity
properties.description: Connects this trigger to its content panel via aria-controls.

properties.name: Content ID
properties.description: Set this to the same value as the Content ID on the matching Navigation Menu Content so aria-controls points at the right panel.

properties.name: Settings
properties.description: Controls trigger interaction mode, disabled state, and optional arrow display.

properties.name: Disabled
properties.description: Disables the trigger so it cannot open or close its panel.

properties.name: Show Arrow
properties.description: Shows the chevron icon inside the trigger button.

properties.name: Trigger Action
properties.description: Chooses whether the trigger opens on hover or click. In Etch, hover behaves like click for reliable editing.

properties.name: Styling
properties.description: Classes applied to the trigger button.

properties.name: CSS Class
properties.description: Default style preset for the navigation trigger button.

properties.description: Connects this panel to its trigger so the trigger can point at it via aria-controls.

properties.name: Styling
properties.description: Classes applied to the dropdown or mega-menu content panel.

properties.name: CSS Class
properties.description: Default style preset for the content panel wrapper.

1847.description: Dropdown panel content for navigation menu.

properties.description: Defines the visible label used by the generated mobile drawer UI.

properties.description: Label used for this node inside the generated mobile drawer.

properties.name: Link Mode
properties.description: Shows link settings only when this node is configured to render as a link.

properties.description: Link settings used when this explicit mobile node renders as a link.

properties.name: Href
properties.description: Destination URL used only when settings.useAs is set to link.

properties.name: Styling
properties.description: Optional classes applied to the authored mobile item wrapper.

properties.name: CSS Class
properties.description: Optional class list for the authored wrapper element.

properties.name: Identity
properties.description: Shared identifier used to find the desktop Navigation Menu and wire the internal Drawer.

properties.name: Settings
properties.description: Controls the internal drawer direction and dismissal behavior.

properties.description: Edge the internal drawer should slide from.

properties.name: Dismissible

properties.name: Content

properties.description: When enabled, the trigger displays visible label text. When disabled, only an icon is shown and a separate aria label is used for accessibility.

properties.name: Trigger Label Enabled
properties.description: Trigger label settings visible only when Show Trigger Label is enabled.

properties.name: Trigger Label

properties.name: Trigger Aria Label Enabled
